_note: The first-day checklist (design spec section 19.4). The server checks each step in public.first_day_status() and pays the reward set in app_settings.app_bonus.first_day.
title: Your first day in Dubai

steps.title: Plan your budget
steps.text: Choose where you live and how you get around.

steps.title: Work your first shift
steps.text: Get a job on the Job Board (City Metro hires on the spot) or ask shop staff, then work a shift.

steps.title: Pass your first lesson
steps.text: Enrol in Academic City and pass a lesson quiz.

steps.title: Add a friend
steps.text: Tap someone in a venue or find them in your phone, then add them.

steps.title: Turn on notifications
steps.text: Know when friends message, knock or pay you. Has its own bonus.
